# RAR fixtures

These small archives come from libarchive v3.7.4 test fixtures:

- `rar4.rar`: decoded from `libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar.rar.uu`; contains text, directories, and a safe relative symbolic link.
- `rar5.rar`: decoded from `libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar5_compressed.rar.uu`; contains a compressed 1200-byte `test.bin`.

Source: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/v3.7.4/libarchive/test
License: BSD, as reproduced in `libarchive-COPYING`.
